content: LLM agent safety literature converges on: (1) tool/action allowlists validated pre-execution, (2) argument validation, (3) rate limits/cooldowns, (4) sandboxing/scoping blast radius, (5) pre-execution policy/guardrail check that runs in code (not model-decided) before any side-effecting call, separate from the model's own reasoning. This matches Agent K's Law 2 design: a code-based policy module gating the single allowlisted rollback action on SLO/burn-rate breach + allowlist membership + cooldown + confidence threshold + deployment-cause + sandbox scope, evaluated deterministically after the LLM proposes an action but before execution.
